spec_meta.positive_lean:
namespace PubDV06

def offDiag : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => offDiag n + n

theorem ordered_pairs_diag_split (n : Nat) : n + 2 * offDiag n = n * n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [offDiag, Nat.mul_add]
    rw [Nat.add_mul m 1 m, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_one]
    omega

end PubDV06
